mentions.name: Forth News Pro
mentions.description: News monitoring web app (an extension of forth.news) that exposes and organizes hundreds of newsworthy primary sources — statements, press releases, press pool reports, emergency alerts, etc. — collected from press email lists, X/Twitter, Bluesky, and RSS. It presents sources in a TweetDeck-style panel UI and sends notifications. Its latest update lets some panels be based on an LLM prompt (e.g. "everything about the Iran War and its effects in the U.S.") that searches the entire catalog of sources as they are posted.

Latest update now allows some panels to be based on an LLM prompt (i.e. "everything about the Iran War and its effects in the U.S.") which searches the entire catalog of sources as they are posted.

mentions.name: Forth
mentions.description: A news site that constantly pulls updates from primary and official sources, uses AI to group them into cohesive story timelines, write summaries, and assign urgency levels for sorting, while also sharing reporting from trusted, vetted journalists. It aims to combine the speed and breadth of updates straight from the source with the perspective and context that reporting provides.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a new kind of news site, featuring updates from primary sources.

We're constantly pulling info from official sources, and using AI to group and summarize into stories, and continue to share reporting from trusted, vetted journalists.
